author: Thomas Barnet-Lamb, Toby Gee, David Geraghty and Richard Taylor
title: Potential automorphy and change of weight
locators: pp. 509–510 on reciprocity and Hodge–Tate numbers
§2.1, pp. 536–537 on algebraic weights and polarization
statement_used: A regular algebraic cuspidal polarized input over a CM field has a continuous semisimple Galois representation. The theorem gives the normalized local parameter away from the coefficient prime, the jumps at every embedding, and local compatibility and crystallinity at a spherical place above the prime.
dictionary: The authors’ F/F+ is E/F here. The sign of the polarizing character at every real place is (-1)^a.
The coefficient representation is dualized. Reversing its highest weight gives H_tau = {(a-1)/2-z}.
A spherical fixed vector is Iwahori-fixed at the given place. Geometric Frobenius has eigenvalues q^((a-1)/2) times the normalized Satake roots.

not_claimed: The odd-rank geometric seed and stable-range unitary lifts.
